integrity: All statements follow from a finite tilted generator determinant and spectral gap; standalone exact symbolic and independently integrated moment equations checked. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-state, constant-speed, exponential four-heading dynamics; fourth-cumulant rates, not finite-time sign at zero-rate boundaries. Existing three-rate Fourier-Laplace resolvent can implicitly encode the formulas and remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp two-mechanism threshold for directional fourth-cumulant sectors in a four-heading active walker
